column1: # memra#1321 review fold: the mechanism cells on one RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q card, calibrated to the laptop's boot (2026-11-18).
# LABEL<TAB>MODE<TAB>COMMAND; see maxq-cells.sh. Arms dmain2f / ds2h2f (the positive control) / ds2if: the 5090 cell's arms plus the
# MEMRA_DIAG_LAPTOP_ARMS door (prefill workspace charged held, batch OOM recovery on); MEMRA_DSPARK_PREFIX_RESTORE=0.
# emul:25363: the card held to 25,363 MiB free (total less used) before each boot, which gives the server the laptop's driver free after
# boot (the first forced rows, at 24,390, read 3,648 MiB at calibration-complete against the laptop's 4,621).
# --keeper-fresh --keeper-sleep 2: this card decodes the keeper's 20,000 tokens in seconds, so a new keeper starts right before each
# placed row and is decoding during the prime's two calls, as on the laptop. Not a 5090 capacity row.
# Card 3's share: the 100 MiB first-row boots, six per arm.
